system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
There were 5 children at the park. Some were wearing hats and some were not.

| Girls | Boys |
| --- | --- |
| Maria was wearing a hat | Peter was wearing a hat |
| Megan was not wearing a hat | Chan was not wearing a hat |
| Mandy was not wearing a hat | |

Complete the table to show the number of boys and girls that were wearing hats and were not wearing hats.

| | Hat | No hat |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boys | | |
| Girls | | |

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Fill in the table as follows. Boys row: Hat = 1 (Peter), No hat = 1 (Chan). Girls row: Hat = 1 (Maria), No hat = 2 (Megan and Mandy). The completed table is: | | Hat | No hat | / | Boys | 1 | 1 | / | Girls | 1 | 2 |

llm_thinking: Tallying it up: Peter and Chan are boys, one with a hat and one without; Maria, Megan, and Mandy are girls, one with a hat and two without. That gives one hat and one no-hat for boys, one hat and two no-hats for girls. I'll format this as a single-line JSON output without markdown.
